commits.message: test(colour): the menu bytes draw the named activated shades over rich-js 0.25's arrows (candybar-joiners-e5r4.dg6)
test(colour): drop the DecorEntry import the deleted row-ground test left unread (candybar-joiners-e5r4.dg6)

docs(colour): the colour design doc states the open menu's named shades, not the search they replaced (candybar-joiners-e5r4.dg6)

COLOUR-FROM-THEME-VOCABULARY.md is ACTIVE and is where the colour memory
sends a reader for the rationale, but its rule, region table and
disclosure rules still described the state search, the plane's
recession and the floors as current. They now state the selected
shades; a dg6 entry in Decisions says what it supersedes and points to
PROPOSAL-joiners.md for why, and "What was deleted" lists the symbols.
test(colour): the palette-identity walk names its one exemption, and why authored backgrounds need none (candybar-joiners-e5r4.dg6)

fix(colour): the activated segment and its menu plane wear named theme shades; the inter-cell floors go (candybar-joiners-e5r4.dg6)

The segment whose menu is open, the ✕ and blank leads of that menu's rows,
and the plane the rows sit on now select colours the theme names, the way
every closed cell already does. The activated state is the menu hue at a new
`activated` column of the shade table: the hue's muted form on every window
of the ladder, its second lightening on the `muted` position. The plane is
`surface` at every depth. Items are unchanged.

Deleted: the open-trigger colour search and its rays, the plane blend and
its floors, the band item repair at 256 and ansi, every floor stated in
STATE_FLOOR, BAND_FLOORS or SEAM_MIN_DELTA_E, the shortfalls a band carried,
and the `band-floor` render warning with its cases in check and the daemon.
A disclosure no longer carries the ground its row dealt, since nothing reads
it. Text is unchanged: it is still chosen to clear AA on whatever it is
drawn on.

feat(tmux): the tmux status line is a renderer the config menu offers inside tmux, and a handed-off statusline is one small row (candybar-plugins-vf6g.qzx)

fix(render): bump rich-js to 0.25 so every join is an arrow, and the tests say so (candybar-joiners-e5r4.0hr) (#496)

* test: any divider between two neighbouring cells fails (brandon-menus-sjhy.57p)

Brandon: "Take any tests that assert this state and reverse them, so any
occurance of this state makes the tests fail." The equal-bg test, the menu
seams' theme's-own allowance, the 256/ansi divider floor and the theme
identity audit's divider rule each accepted the divider; each now fails on it.

* fix(render): bump rich-js to 0.25 so every join is an arrow, and the tests say so (candybar-joiners-e5r4.0hr)

rich-js 0.25's joiner has no divider: it always draws its seam and lifts
an arrow's ink off a ground it would vanish into. The seam adapters
follow the new SeamForm (plainWith has no divider; the glyph probe draws
two cells), the glyph lists and doctor fixtures lose U+E0B1, and the
docs' render fences and the two byte snapshots show U+E0B0 where U+E0B1
was, each a lifted arrow between the door and its rate cell.

The reversed tests' arrow checks read the lift: in colour-256 an arrow's
ink is its cell's ground wherever that stands off the next ground as
drawn, and otherwise the colour rich-js's own joiner draws for the two
truecolor grounds, at truecolor, 256 and ansi. The theme-identity audit
reads an arrow's left side from the column before it, since the ink no
longer says it.

The 33 other rich-js commits in 0.25.0 change four APIs the render
uses: Effected takes its time from RenderOptions.frame, an effect frame
carries CellLook attributes, Transition is a class with a schedule, and
animationFuncs takes a TemplateFrame (only frames and stepped are
registered, as before).

* fix(render): a passage keeps only the effect it draws, and each depth of a bar is compared at one instant (candybar-joiners-e5r4.0hr)

High review pass on #496:
- Passage keeps the transition's done and its grounded effect, never the transition as made, whose own effect veils toward the terminal's ground.
- colour-256 draws every render of a comparison at one instant, so the depths compared are the same bar glyph for glyph.
- The audit, segment-render-unit and engine comments say what rich-js 0.25 does: one ground gets a lifted arrow; tween, loop and glyphs are refused as unknown functions.

* fix(deps): require rich-js ^0.25.1, since 0.25.0's color module reads `pattern` before its import and no suite loads under ts-jest (candybar-joiners-e5r4.0hr)

* docs(render): the unregistered animation functions and the seams test say what is drawn (candybar-joiners-e5r4.0hr)

Medium review pass on #496: engine.ts gives the reason tween, loop and glyphs are not registered, and what registering each takes; settings-menu-seams' header says two rungs spelled alike share a ground under a lifted arrow.
